prompt:
Edit this exact Chinese dungeon exploration UI into ONE material refinement: GRADIENT BLACK FROSTED GLASS backplate + CHARCOAL surface layering + SPARING BLUE/CYAN highlights. Output the same1672x941 landscape composition.

STRICTLY PRESERVE the current layout and every functional element:
- Full-width moonlit castle/skull/candles/raven scenery at top, unchanged.
- The inset lower console position and dimensions, broad empty left gutter and narrower empty right gutter. Do not expand the console or add UI to these reserved gutters.
- Header/progress/invasion status; all node positions and route connections; right node dossier; five-category reward ribbon.
- The enlarged blue "进入节点" primary action in the middle area of the bottom dock.
- Both smaller exit actions stacked on the RIGHT of that bottom dock, exact labels "安全撤离" and "强制放弃", with "仅起点可用 · 保留战利品", "丢失背包全部物品", "需二次确认". Do not move them or remove warnings.
- All Chinese text, numerical values, fonts, icon meanings and room labels.

MATERIAL EDIT, visibly different from the dead-flat pure-black source:
Replace the monolithic black console fill with sophisticated DARK SMOKED/FROSTED GLASS. It should still read unequivocally BLACK and CHARCOAL, not a blue slab and not light/milky gray glass.
Main backplate: gentle neutral near-black gradient, around #080b0e at lower/right edge through #14191e at upper/left, with a very broad soft charcoal reflection. Add extremely subtle frosted microtexture, no visible grain dots. Convey heavy tint with roughly90-94% opacity, faint diffuse cool environmental light underneath, strong blur of anything seen through it. There must be NO recognizable duplicated castle, paths, stone edges, text, or imagery behind the route or labels. Keep their backgrounds clean.
Use a slim soft outer shadow to separate the inset panel from the darker empty side gutters. Along the top edge, a single fine silver-gray grazing reflection, fading at corners. Very slight glass thickness at the bevel, not several heavy chrome rails.

CHARCOAL LAYERING:
- Map bed: the darkest matte smoked-black inset (#0b0e11 approximate), with a subtle broad gradient and clean readable negative space. No busy decorative map/circuit lines.
- Header, expected-rewards band, and node dossier: slightly lighter charcoal (#171c21 approximate) with a smooth soft gradient, visibly distinct but restrained. Section differences should come from tone and spacing, not many framed boxes.
- Bottom action dock: dark charcoal-black, subtle frosted reflection, separating it from map without a heavy bar.
- Reduce brightness of repeated internal silver border lines; use fine translucent gray dividers and one delicate outer rim. Preserve the existing chamfered silhouette and cold-steel character. No ornamental curls, extra screws or added motifs.
- Keep all foreground labels and icons CRISP, never apply blur to text, symbols, node rims or routes. Glass blur applies only to surface/backdrop appearance.

BLUE/CYAN HIGHLIGHTS SPARINGLY:
Preserve cyan selected route and selected node outline, but tighten the glow so it is focused and not neon fog. Small cyan section accents and the entry button rim remain. Keep the primary entry button a restrained smoky STEEL BLUE gradient, with soft cyan edge light, instead of saturated neon fill. Other surfaces stay neutral black/charcoal; no broad cyan floodlights or blue gradients across the panel. Silver-gray icons and off-white Chinese typography unchanged. Risk/loss warnings retain warm red, safe status retains small green dot.

Aim for a refined semi-transparent dark-glass instrument panel with clear tonal depth, tactile but understated cold-steel trim, comfortable readability and the exact current integrated controls. It must look less flat and less like stacked metal cages while retaining the accepted black overall mood. Do NOT redesign composition, replace glyphs, add components, change navigation, alter values or shrink controls. One finished image, no annotations or comparison.
scope: Gradient smoked-black glass appearance, charcoal layering, limited blue/cyan highlights. Existing inset console, middle primary action and right exits retained.
limitations: Raster image only approximates glass and typography; no actual backdrop-filter, blur performance or runtime readability verification. No code/config/official asset changes and no tests.
